moments.title: UK Singles Chart Latest
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift holds the top spot with 'Patient Zero' as new entries from Noah Kahan and Drake shake up the charts.

angles.name: Swift's Reign Continues
angles.copy: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is still dominating the UK Singles Chart! Is it her best track from the new era? #TaylorSwift

angles.name: New Entries Alert
angles.copy: New music alert! Noah Kahan's 'Draw You Out' and a trio of Drake tracks are making waves on the Official Singles Chart. What's your favourite new entry?

angles.name: Spiro & Dean
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds strong at Number 2, while Olivia Dean's 'I've Seen It' is a notable new entry. Two incredible female artists making their mark!

moments.title: Liverpool vs Man City Showdown
moments.blurb: Two Premier League giants, Liverpool and Manchester City, clash today at Anfield in a highly anticipated fixture.

angles.name: Match Day Hype
angles.copy: It's the ultimate Premier League showdown today! Liverpool host Manchester City at Anfield – who are you backing to win? Kick-off 4:30 PM BST.

angles.name: Title Race Impact
angles.copy: A massive game in the title race today as Liverpool take on Man City. Will we see a shift at the top of the table? Tune in!

moments.title: Lionesses World Cup Play-Off
moments.blurb: The England Women's team faces Greece on Tuesday in the second leg of their FIFA 2027 World Cup European Qualifier play-off.

angles.name: Lionesses in Action
angles.copy: Our Lionesses are back! England Women take on Greece this Tuesday at 7:30 PM BST in a crucial World Cup Qualifier play-off. Let's get behind them!

angles.name: Road to World Cup
angles.copy: It's the second leg of the World Cup play-off for England Women on Tuesday at King Power Stadium. Can they secure their spot?

moments.title: Happy 79th, Daryl Hall!
moments.blurb: Daryl Hall, half of the iconic duo Hall & Oates, celebrates his 79th birthday today.

angles.name: Daryl Hall Turns 79
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the legendary Daryl Hall! What's your favourite Hall & Oates track? We're playing the best all day!

angles.name: Hall & Oates Classics
angles.copy: From 'Rich Girl' to 'Maneater', Daryl Hall gave us so many classics. Celebrating his 79th today!

moments.title: MC Lyte's 55th Birthday
moments.blurb: Pioneering rapper MC Lyte celebrates her 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday MC Lyte
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to the incredible MC Lyte! A true trailblazer in hip-hop, her influence is undeniable.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Results
moments.blurb: Tonight, find out who is leaving the Strictly Come Dancing ballroom in the latest results show on BBC One.

angles.name: Strictly Sunday
angles.copy: Who faced the dance-off and who is going home? Catch up with all the drama on tonight's Strictly Come Dancing Results on BBC One at 7:10 PM!

moments.title: Sunday Night Drama Showdown
moments.blurb: It's a clash of new dramas tonight with David Tennant's 'Time' on BBC One and 'The Party' on ITV1, both at 9 PM.

angles.name: Time vs The Party
angles.copy: What are you watching tonight? It's a tough choice with David Tennant in 'Time' (BBC One) and 'The Party' (ITV1) both starting at 9 PM. Decisions, decisions!

moments.title: BFI London Film Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The 70th BFI London Film Festival is in full swing, showcasing international cinema, TV productions, and documentaries until October 18.

angles.name: Film Festival Buzz
angles.copy: London is buzzing with the BFI London Film Festival! Catch international premieres and compelling documentaries until October 18.

moments.title: Cheltenham Literature Festival
moments.blurb: The Cheltenham Literature Festival continues until October 18, bringing together authors, poets, and public conversations.

angles.name: Literary Feast
angles.copy: For bookworms and culture vultures, the Cheltenham Literature Festival is still on until October 18! Who are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Scottish Schools Half Term
moments.blurb: Schools across Scotland begin their October half-term break from tomorrow, Monday, October 12, running until October 16.

angles.name: Half Term Scotland
angles.copy: Happy Half Term, Scotland! Schools are out from tomorrow, Monday 12th October, until the 16th. What are your plans for the week?

moments.title: Exmoor Dark Skies Festival
moments.blurb: The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival begins on Friday, October 16, offering stargazing events until November 1.

angles.name: Look Up to Exmoor
angles.copy: Get ready to gaze! The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival kicks off this Friday, October 16th, celebrating the stunning night sky. Perfect for a Westcountry escape!

moments.title: Welsh Rugby Premiership Action
moments.blurb: The Admiral WRU Premiership sees several matches take place next Saturday, October 17, including Beddau vs Bargoed and Pontypridd vs Merthyr.

angles.name: Welsh Rugby Weekend
angles.copy: Big weekend for Welsh club rugby next Saturday! Admiral WRU Premiership action includes Beddau vs Bargoed and Pontypridd vs Merthyr. Get ready for some thrilling rugby!

moments.title: An Evening with Matt Le Tissier in Tiverton
moments.blurb: Former Southampton and England star Matt Le Tissier will be at Tiverton Town Football Club for an evening event on Thursday, October 15.

angles.name: Le Tissier in Tiverton
angles.copy: Football legend Matt Le Tissier is coming to Tiverton Town FC this Thursday, October 15th, for a special evening! Don't miss out, Devon.

moments.title: Halloween Preparations Underway
moments.blurb: With Halloween just around the corner, spooky events are starting across the UK, including pumpkin picking and themed attractions.

angles.name: Spooky Season Begins
angles.copy: Feeling spooky yet? Halloween is approaching, and pumpkin patches are open! What are your favourite autumn traditions?
